title: NYCU OAuth Token Response
description: The token payload returned by POST https://id.nycu.edu.tw/o/token/ on a successful authorization-code exchange. Shape transcribed from the worked example in the university's own developer documentation at https://id.nycu.edu.tw/docs/.

expires_in.description: Access-token lifetime in seconds; 36000 in the documented example.

refresh_token.description: Token for renewing the access token.
